title: Parallel test gate (nextest plus doctests) and batched task-record reads

criteria: the ship and check test gate runs test binaries in parallel through cargo nextest, with a doctest gate for the selected library packages
nextest and doctest results are counted from their real output and fail closed on incomplete or failing runs
the provenance verifier accepts a nextest workspace gate only with its doctest gate
task records are read with one ls-tree and one batched cat-file
